summary: -i controls the timed local SpMV repetition loop. The root's nondecreasing row boundaries start at 0 and terminate at numRows; every row block receives its delimiter-derived contiguous nonzero interval, rebased to local offsets. The compiled traversal still loads and multiplies each CSR entry, accumulates, and stores each row. Repeated A*x overwrites are intentional.

source_evidence.claim: The parsed -i count controls timed iterations. rowStart[0] is zero, interior cuts are monotone, and the final cut is numRows; row, nonzero and delimiter counts/displacements match each contiguous block, after which local delimiters are rebased.
The local CSR routine walks all local rows and every nonzero between consecutive delimiters, performs value-times-vector accumulation, and writes each row result.

compiled_evidence.claim: Native code following the timed MPI_Wtime start retains the iteration counter/backedge at a1ec-a1f0. The row loop at a190-a1ea and nonzero loop at a1c0-a1dc include delimiter/column/vector/value loads, multiply/add accumulation, and the row store at a1de.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. Directly checked r2 and r3 CSR partitions, complete local row/nonzero traversals, timed repetition loops, and emitted native loads/multiply/add/stores plus all three loop backedges. r2 uses root send/receive of adjacent slices; r3 uses Scatterv and rebased delimiters. No missing repetitions or CSR work identified.
primary_quality_check.timestamp_provenance: Conservative enclosing interval, not exact review duration: 22:07:09Z is the parent-observed launch lower bound and 22:09:49Z was clock-observed by the reviewer near completion.
